title: add-query-importance-labeller-and-prioritized-failure-summarizer-ci-adapter
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: some prompt-sets yield concentrated but high-impact regression failures in a small subset of queries. Current CI gates surface aggregate metrics (e.g., overall accuracy delta) but do not prioritize which failures matter most for product experience or operational cost. This PR introduces two related pieces: 1) a Query Importance Labeller (QIL) that assigns a traffic-aware importance score to each query/prompt in a prompt-set, combining real traffic weight, business tags, and a perturbation-sensitivity signal; and 2) a Prioritized Failure Summarizer (PFS) that ranks regression failures by an actionable Failure Priority Rank (FPR) and emits a concise, explainable summary for the top-N failures suitable for incident channels and triage playbooks. Both are exposed as a CI adapter so quality gates can optionally fail merges when high-PIS (Prompt Importance Score) queries regress by severity thresholds.
changes_summary: Adds a lightweight scoring pipeline (qil/) plus a summarizer service (pfs/) and a CI adapter that plugs into existing eval orchestration. Includes unit + smoke tests and a backfill helper to compute historical PIS/FPR over archived eval traces.
commits: init: scaffold Query Importance Labeller module and README
feat: implement traffic-weighted PIS + perturbation sensitivity estimator
feat: add Prioritized Failure Summarizer and explainability output (token saliency snippets)
test: add unit tests for scoring heuristics and CI adapter integration
docs: document how to tune PIS thresholds and CI behavior
files_snippets: qil/importance.py: def compute_pis(query, traffic_weight, sensitivity): return traffic_weight * (1 + sensitivity * 0.7)
pfs/summarizer.py: # top-5 FPR summary: returns [(query_id, fpr, explanation_snippet)]
ci/adapters/pis_gate.py: if top_failing_pis_weighted_score >= threshold: raise QualityGateError('PIS gate triggered')
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Nice approach. Question: how do we avoid amplifying noise from low-volume queries with high sensitivity? Suggest adding a minimum volume floor or smoothing — see inline on importance.py.
Maya Chen (reply): Added volume_floor param and low-pass smoothing; default floor is 50 samples to avoid noisy amplification. Updated tests to exercise the floor behavior.
Elena Gomez: Can the summarizer output include token-level saliency so SREs can triage quickly? Also please add an opt-in backfill to compute historic PIS to avoid one-off failures on new label runs.
Maya Chen (reply): token_level saliency included under pfs/explainers. Backfill tool added as tools/backfill_pis.py; it can be run incrementally and has a memory-efficient reader for archived traces.
Samir Venkataraman: CI adapter should be conservative by default. Please expose configuration (fail/soft-fail/notify) in eval pipeline config and document it.
Maya Chen (reply): Exposed 'mode' and 'top_n' in ci/adapters/pis_gate.py and documented behavior in docs/pis-fpr-guide.md. Default is "soft-fail" with notification to #eval-alerts.
Elena Gomez (approval): Approving after tests pass and minor doc nits fixed.
release_notes: Add Query Importance Labeller (PIS) and Prioritized Failure Summarizer (FPR). New CI adapter 'pis_gate' to allow merges to be gated by prioritized failure impact. Includes token-level saliency explainers and a backfill tool for historical scoring.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover scoring edge cases (volume floor, extreme sensitivity). Backfill tool tested on a 6-month eval trace sample; performance: ~1.2s per eval trace on dev machine, memory-mapped reader to avoid OOM.
how_to_use: 1) Run tools/backfill_pis.py --from 2025-08-01 --to 2026-02-01 to compute historic PIS/FPR. 2) Tweak ci/adapters/pis_gate.py thresholds in eval pipeline config: mode=(soft-fail|fail|notify), top_n=5, pis_threshold=0.15. 3) Review generated report at /tmp/pfs-report-<run_id>.json or send to #eval-alerts.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: mis-calibrated PIS can suppress marginal but important regressions. Mitigation: default CI mode is soft-fail and requires manual opt-in to hard-fail; PIS includes volume_floor and smoothing; documented calibration steps in docs/pis-fpr-guide.md.
